sections.title: NRN AND CNTRL PLAINS INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: 12Z UPPER-AIR ANALYSIS AND MORNING WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOW A LARGE-SCALE TROUGH PROGRESSING EWD THROUGH THE GREAT BASIN INTO CNTRL ROCKIES. WITHIN THIS BROADER REGIME...THE TROUGH APPEARS TO BE COMPOSED OF THREE DISTINCT IMPULSES...ONE OVER CNTRL CO...ANOTHER NEAR THE UT/CO BORDER AND THE STRONGEST OVER WRN UT. ELSEWHERE...ANOTHER WEAK IMPULSE WILL PROGRESS EWD FROM CNTRL MT INTO ND. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE OVER S-CNTRL SD WILL DEEPEN TODAY WHILE DEVELOPING QUITE SLOWLY EWD/NEWD. A LEE OR PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH WILL CONCURRENTLY STRENGTHEN FROM THIS LOW SWWD THROUGH WRN/CNTRL NEB TO THE CO/KS BORDER. ELSEWHERE...A BAROCLINIC ZONE FROM ERN MT SEWD TO THE SD SURFACE LOW...EWD ACROSS SRN MN INTO CNTRL WI WILL UNDERGO DEFORMATION THROUGH THE PERIOD...WITH THE SEGMENT OF FRONT E OF THE LOW LIFTING NWD...WHILE THE WRN EXTENSION IS OVERTAKEN BY A COLD FRONT MOVING SEWD THROUGH THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. A WELL-DEFINED EML WAS OBSERVED THIS MORNING ACROSS MUCH OF THE REGION WITH CONSIDERABLE WARMING EXPECTED TO OCCUR TODAY IN THE 850-500 MB LAYER OVER THE LOWER ELEVATIONS OF THE NRN/CNTRL PLAINS. sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: PRE-FRONTAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PROGRESS SEWD FROM SWRN ONTARIO INTO THE REGION TODAY WITHIN A WARM AND MODESTLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WHERE MLCAPE WILL APPROACH 500-1000 J/KG. STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES MAY PROMOTE A FEW LOCALLY STRONGER DOWNDRAFTS WITH THE THREAT FOR GUSTY WINDS. HOWEVER...POOR MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MARGINAL VERTICAL SHEAR ARE EXPECTED TO PRECLUDE AN ORGANIZED SEVERE WEATHER THREAT.

sections.title: UT/CO
sections.text: STRONG VORTICITY MAXIMUM CURRENTLY MOVING INTO WRN UT IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT EWD ACROSS THE REGION TODAY WITHIN A ZONE OF CONCENTRATED LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT. 12Z SLC/LKN SOUNDINGS SHOWED THE PRESENCE OF A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT PRECEDING THIS UPPER SYSTEM. GIVEN THE AREA OF CLEARING NOTED ON VISIBLE SATELLITE AHEAD OF TSTMS OVER WRN UT...IT APPEARS THAT AT LEAST MODEST DAYTIME HEATING WILL OCCUR. AS SUCH...EXPECT POCKETS OF MODEST CONVECTIVE INSTABILITY TO DEVELOP WITH SBCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J/K...SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF DIURNALLY-ENHANCED STORMS...A FEW OF WHICH WILL BE CAPABLE OF STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SOME HAIL. ..MEAD/SMITH.. 08/19/2010
